supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:40–13:40:43 UTC, the domain controller issued a service ticket for sean.byrne to WS-ACOLE-01 from 10.56.10.23, and WS-ACOLE-01 recorded a successful network logon for sean.byrne from that address.

At 13:43:06 UTC, PowerShell ran as sean.byrne with the command to execute \\FILE-ORC-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1. This matches the supplied IT practice for workstation patching and is consistent with the reported brief PowerShell appearance, though it occurred a few minutes after the reported approximate time.
That PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 KB update quietly, then both wusa.exe and PowerShell exited shortly afterward.

The recorded user, script path, and update-installation activity align with the supplied business-hours patching schedule and documented IT procedure; the available evidence therefore supports a benign explanation for the alerted PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show a PowerShell process launch and command line, but do not contain the contents or integrity verification of Patch-Workstations.ps1.
The records do not establish whether Amy saw this specific process window or exactly when it appeared.
claims_not_established: Whether the script contents on the file share were unchanged and authorized at execution time.
Whether the observed launch precisely matches the window Amy reported seeing around 13:40 UTC.
unrelated_findings: At 13:47 UTC, taskhostw.exe on WS-ACOLE-01 attempted explicit authentication as svc-safe; the inventory describes svc-safe as a backup agent account on FILE-ORC-01. This warrants separate review and does not determine the disposition of the PowerShell alert. Records: T294-00142, T294-00146, T294-00147.

At 14:13 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 used a Zscaler Client Connector user agent to connect to config.zscaler.net; Zscaler is not among the services listed as approved in the supplied context. Review separately; this does not determine the disposition of the PowerShell alert. Records: T294-00245, T294-00246.
